-- ============================================
-- MM2 Full Trade Bot v2 — GUI Signal Based
-- Generated by Cobalt — https://gitlab.com/upio/cobalt
-- Flow: SendRequest → OfferItem → Wait for accept button → AcceptTrade → Leave
-- No status polling — pure GUI signal driven
-- ============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Trade = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Trade", 10)
local SendRequest    = Trade:WaitForChild("SendRequest", 10)
local OfferItem      = Trade:WaitForChild("OfferItem", 10)
local AcceptTrade    = Trade:WaitForChild("AcceptTrade", 10)
local GetTradeStatus = Trade:WaitForChild("GetTradeStatus", 10)

local TARGET_USERNAME = "aquxtic_jaz"
local ITEM_DATAID     = "Strawberries_G_2026"
local ITEM_TYPE       = "Weapons"

-- *knows the path, no detours*

local function safeCall(fn, label)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    if ok then
        print("[CobaltBot] " .. label .. " ✓")
    else
        warn("[CobaltBot] " .. label .. " FAILED: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

-- ── Wait for TradeGUI accept button to appear ─────────────────────────────────
local function waitForAcceptButton(gui)
    -- MM2 accept button is typically named "AcceptButton" inside TradeGUI
    -- we scan descendants for it becoming visible
    local timeout = 30
    local elapsed = 0
    while elapsed < timeout do
        -- try common button names MM2 uses
        local btn = gui:FindFirstChild("AcceptButton", true)
                 or gui:FindFirstChild("Accept", true)
                 or gui:FindFirstChild("AcceptBtn", true)
        if btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") and btn.Visible then
            print("[CobaltBot] Accept button found: " .. btn.Name)
            return true
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
        elapsed = elapsed + 0.3
    end
    -- fallback — just wait 6s flat (MM2 trade timer is ~6s before accept unlocks)
    warn("[CobaltBot] Accept button not found by name — using 6s flat timer fallback")
    task.wait(6)
    return true
end

-- ── Get target player ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function getTarget()
    local t = 0
    local target
    repeat
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
        target = Players:FindFirstChild(TARGET_USERNAME)
    until target or t >= 15
    return target
end

-- ── Watch for trade completion then leave ─────────────────────────────────────
local function watchAndLeave(tradeGui)
    -- when TradeGUI closes after being open = trade done or cancelled
    -- *waits for the door to shut, then heads for the exit*
    local closed = false
    local conn
    conn = tradeGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if not tradeGui.Enabled then
            closed = true
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
    local t = 0
    while not closed and t < 20 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    print("[CobaltBot] Trade window closed — leaving ✓")
    task.wait(1)
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end

-- ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function run()
    print("[CobaltBot] Starting — looking for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. "...")

    local target = getTarget()
    if not target then
        warn("[CobaltBot] " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. " not in server. Stopping.")
        return
    end
    print("[CobaltBot] Found " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. " ✓")

    -- send trade request
    safeCall(function()
        SendRequest:InvokeServer(target)
    end, "SendRequest")

    -- wait for TradeGUI to open (they accepted our request)
    print("[CobaltBot] Waiting for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. " to accept request...")
    local tradeGui = nil
    local guiOpened = false

    local desktopGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI", 30)
    local phoneGui   = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI_Phone", 30)

    local function onGuiEnabled(gui)
        if not guiOpened then
            guiOpened = true
            tradeGui = gui
        end
    end

    local c1 = desktopGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if desktopGui.Enabled then onGuiEnabled(desktopGui) end
    end)
    local c2 = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if phoneGui.Enabled then onGuiEnabled(phoneGui) end
    end)

    -- poll wait for gui open
    local t = 0
    while not guiOpened and t < 30 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    c1:Disconnect()
    c2:Disconnect()

    if not guiOpened then
        warn("[CobaltBot] " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. " never accepted — stopping.")
        return
    end

    print("[CobaltBot] Trade GUI open ✓ — offering item...")
    task.wait(0.5)

    -- offer YOUR item
    safeCall(function()
        OfferItem:FireServer(ITEM_DATAID, ITEM_TYPE)
    end, "OfferItem")

    task.wait(0.5)

    -- wait for accept button / timer
    waitForAcceptButton(tradeGui)

    -- fire accept
    safeCall(function()
        AcceptTrade:FireServer()
    end, "AcceptTrade")

    task.wait(0.5)

    -- second accept (MM2 requires confirming twice)
    safeCall(function()
        AcceptTrade:FireServer()
    end, "AcceptTrade confirm")

    -- watch for GUI close then leave
    watchAndLeave(tradeGui)
end

task.spawn(run)
